## What this notebook checks

Test all declared activity categories. Account for repeated reports from the
same participant and similarity between measurements close in time. First test
whether the categories differ overall, then report the planned activity
comparisons in interpretable units. Check whether differences vary by site,
whether every category has enough observations, and whether the model fits each
activity group adequately.

## What this notebook uses and produces

- Uses: the prepared H04 dataset in `artifacts/06_model_data/H04.rds`.
- Produces: the category definitions, overall and activity-specific
  comparisons, fitted models, model checks, estimates with 95% confidence
  intervals, the exact participants, participant-days, hourly observations,
  sites, and activity-category counts used by each model, both overall and for
  every activity category × site combination; tables, figures, and the exact
  data displayed.
- Data sensitivity: fit this identical H04 implementation to the
  manuscript-prepared dataset and compare exact samples, activity × site
  counts, estimates, 95% confidence intervals, diagnostics, and conclusions.
